items.title: Add 'backfill' provenance + pure backfill-decision leaf
items.context: Extend SignatureTagSource in core/experience-layer-types.ts to 'auto' | 'confirmed' | 'backfill'. New pure leaf core/signature-backfill.ts (imports only types): decideBackfill(finding, mappedSig, opts) -> { action: 'fill'|'skip-confirmed'|'skip-has-auto'|'skip-no-mapping'|'skip-empty-sig', signatureTag?, signatureTagSource:'backfill' } — fills only when current signatureTag is empty (or 'auto' when opts.overwriteAuto); never when 'confirmed'; skip when no mapping. Pure, deterministic, no I/O.
items.userSees: A deterministic decision function + a 'backfill' provenance value distinguishing LLM-backfilled tags from auto/confirmed.

happy.desc: decideBackfill(empty signatureTag, valid mappedSig) => action:fill, signatureTag=mappedSig, signatureTagSource=backfill; WHY: covers primary fill path
decideBackfill(source=confirmed, valid mappedSig) => action:skip-confirmed, no signatureTag in result; WHY: confirmed must never be overwritten
decideBackfill(source=auto, valid mappedSig, overwriteAuto:false) => action:skip-has-auto; WHY: auto preserved unless explicit override
decideBackfill(source=auto, valid mappedSig, overwriteAuto:true) => action:fill with backfill source; WHY: overwriteAuto enables auto replacement
decideBackfill(any current, undefined mappedSig) => action:skip-no-mapping; WHY: unmapped findings must be left alone
SignatureTagSource type in experience-layer-types.ts accepts backfill as valid literal => TypeScript compiles; WHY: type coverage

edge.desc: decideBackfill with signatureTag=undefined AND signatureTagSource=undefined (completely absent fields) + valid mappedSig => action:fill; WHY: real findings may lack these fields entirely
decideBackfill with mappedSig as empty string => action:skip-empty-sig; WHY: empty string is not a valid signature to fill
decideBackfill with opts=undefined (no opts object) => defaults overwriteAuto to false, auto tags preserved; WHY: callers may omit opts
decideBackfill with non-empty signatureTag but signatureTagSource is unknown string (not auto/confirmed) => action:skip-nonempty; WHY: unknown provenance must not be overwritten
Return value always has signatureTagSource=backfill when action=fill, never auto or confirmed; WHY: provenance integrity

adversarial.desc: Static import analysis: signature-backfill.ts imports ONLY from types modules (no fs, path, store, I/O) => leaf is pure; WHY: I/O in the leaf is an architecture violation
decideBackfill never mutates the input finding object => original object byte-identical after call; WHY: mutation would cause hidden side-effects in the caller
overwriteAuto:true with source=confirmed => still skip-confirmed; WHY: confirmed is sacrosanct even when overwriteAuto is on (the strongest invariant)
Passing extra/unexpected properties in finding object does not alter decision logic => same action regardless of extra fields; WHY: defensive against future field additions
Deterministic: identical inputs always produce identical outputs across repeated calls => no hidden state or randomness; WHY: purity contract
Return type structurally exact: action=fill always includes signatureTag+signatureTagSource; action=skip-* never includes signatureTag; WHY: downstream code must not see stale fields

items.title: signature_backfill handler + CLI + register (writing, dry-run default)
items.context: New handlers/signature-backfill.ts: read a committed map file (arg --map, default a documented path) of { findingId -> 'area|failureMode' }; for each story (ctx.store.listStoryIds -> readFindings), apply decideBackfill per finding; with --apply, attach signatureTag+signatureTagSource AFTER the existing _hash (reuse the exact attach pattern from finding.ts; recompute NOTHING in the hashed domain) and writeFindings; default is --dry-run (report counts, write nothing). Flags: dryRun(default true)/apply/overwriteAuto/map/json. Output: scanned/filled/skipped-by-reason + per-source breakdown. Register in cli-engine/registry/config/command-policy(writing, NOT readOnly)/process-fact-levels(L2 experience-layer); NOT in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS.
items.userSees: `lattice signature_backfill --map <file>` dry-runs by default (reports what would change); `--apply` fills empty signatureTags with source=backfill; finding _hash unchanged.

happy.desc: signature_backfill --map <valid-map> without --apply => dry-run output shows scanned/filled/skipped counts, store files byte-identical before/after (nothing written); WHY: dry-run-default is the safety contract
signature_backfill --map <valid-map> --apply => findings with empty signatureTag receive signatureTag from map + signatureTagSource=backfill via store.writeFindings; WHY: primary write path
After --apply, finding _hash is byte-identical to _hash before backfill for every touched finding; WHY: THE critical invariant -- fields attached AFTER _hash domain
Dry-run output includes per-source breakdown (empty/confirmed/auto counts) and per-action tally (fill/skip-confirmed/skip-has-auto/skip-no-mapping); WHY: operator needs actionable report
--json flag produces structured JSON output with all counts, actions, and per-finding decisions; WHY: machine-readable integration
--overwriteAuto combined with --apply overwrites auto-sourced tags with backfill; WHY: intentional override path

signature_backfill registered in all 5 surfaces: registry.ts (registerBatch), cli-engine.ts (command schema), config.ts (DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS), command-policy.ts (writing ownershipClass), process-fact-levels.ts (L2 experience-layer); WHY: incomplete registration breaks discoverability or policy enforcement
signature_backfill is NOT in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS list; WHY: it is a writing command and read-only classification would prevent writes

edge.desc: --map points to file with zero entries (empty JSON {}) => scanned>0, filled=0, all skip-no-mapping; WHY: empty map is a valid but degenerate case
Map contains findingIds that exist in no story => those entries silently ignored, no crash, filled=0 for those entries; WHY: map may be stale or over-inclusive
Store has a story with zero findings => processed without error, contributes scanned=0 for that story; WHY: empty stories should not crash iteration
All findings already have signatureTag+source=backfill => --apply results in filled=0 (all skip-nonempty), writeFindings NOT called; WHY: no-op when already filled
Running without --map arg => clear required-argument error, no writes, no silent default; WHY: no implicit map path
process-fact-levels entry at L2 experience-layer with owner handlers/signature-backfill; WHY: missing entry fails process-fact-contract test

adversarial.desc: After --apply, recompute _hash via real signFinding on every touched finding => byte-identical to stored _hash; WHY: THE critical regression -- if fields leak into hash domain, all finding integrity breaks
Dry-run mode (default) => zero calls to store.writeFindings verified by checking file content/mtime before vs after; WHY: accidental write in dry-run is a data-corruption bug
Static analysis: handler source never imports or calls signFinding => no _hash recomputation possible; WHY: calling signFinding would recompute and change the hash
Static analysis: handler source has no fetch/http/llm/network imports => no LLM or network calls at runtime; WHY: backfill must be offline/deterministic
Map file is malformed JSON => handler throws clear parse error, writes nothing, store uncorrupted; WHY: corrupted map must not corrupt findings
Map file path does not exist on disk => handler throws clear file-not-found error, writes nothing; WHY: missing file must not silently succeed
command-policy entry has writing ownershipClass (like signature_registry_set), NOT readOnly; WHY: misclassification blocks the write path or hides it from audit
Handler does not import or modify finding-verify.ts; WHY: touching verification logic risks breaking finding integrity across the system
Concurrent invocation: two --apply runs on same store => second run is idempotent no-op, no data corruption; WHY: operator may accidentally double-run
READ_ONLY_COMMANDS contamination: signature_backfill must NOT appear in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS => static grep confirms absence; WHY: presence would silently prevent writes

items.title: Smoke + npm script + verifier (incl. _hash invariance + idempotency)
items.context: Hermetic smoke on a temp store with findings (empty / confirmed / auto) + a synthetic map: empty=>filled source=backfill; confirmed=>untouched; auto=>untouched unless overwriteAuto; CRITICAL the finding _hash is byte-identical before/after for every touched finding (real signFinding); dry-run writes nothing; second --apply run is a no-op (idempotent); finding absent from map => skipped. npm script + committed verifier (build + smoke + no-regression + full npm test incl. process-fact-contract; static: leaf pure; handler attaches fields after _hash and never feeds signFinding; registered across the surfaces incl. process-fact-levels; NOT in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS). Maps every intent; TOTAL/PASS/FAIL.
items.userSees: npm smoke passes and the verifier prints PASS incl. the _hash-invariance + idempotency checks.
excludes: No reliance on the real repo in the hermetic test

Verifier prints TOTAL/PASS/FAIL summary with all intents mapped; WHY: evidence gate requires structured pass/fail

adversarial.desc: _hash invariance probe: take a finding, run --apply, then recompute _hash from scratch via real signFinding on the post-backfill finding object => byte-identical to original; WHY: THE critical regression test -- if new fields leak into hash domain, entire finding integrity collapses

Confirmed tag overwrite probe: feed confirmed finding into --apply + overwriteAuto:true => confirmed finding STILL untouched; WHY: overwriteAuto must affect only auto, never confirmed (the strongest invariant)
Accidental write probe: dry-run mode (default) must produce zero file changes => verified by file content hash or mtime comparison; WHY: accidental write in dry-run is silent data corruption
Non-idempotent re-apply probe: run --apply twice, assert second run reports filled=0 and store content byte-identical after both runs; WHY: non-idempotent behavior means double-run corrupts data
Missing PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry probe: verifier static check confirms L2 experience-layer entry exists, prints FAIL if missing; WHY: missing entry breaks process-fact-contract test silently
READ_ONLY_COMMANDS contamination probe: verifier static check confirms signature_backfill NOT in READ_ONLY_COMMANDS, prints FAIL if present; WHY: read-only classification silently disables writes
LLM/network at runtime probe: smoke runs in fully offline hermetic env (no network mocks), any fetch/http call would throw and fail the test; WHY: backfill must be offline-only
Map file missing probe: invoke handler with non-existent map path => clear error thrown, zero writes to store; WHY: missing file must not silently succeed or corrupt
Map file malformed probe: invoke handler with invalid JSON map => clear parse error thrown, zero writes, no store corruption; WHY: corrupted input must not propagate to store
